chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ḥassān al-Wāsiṭī narrated from his uncle, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Kathīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Indeed, the major sins are seven; concerning us they were revealed, and against us they were deemed permissible. The first of them is shirk with Allah, the Magnificent, the killing of the soul which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has forbidden, consuming the wealth of the orphan, disobedience to parents, accusing the chaste woman, fleeing from the battlefield, and denying our right.

As for shirk with Allah, the Magnificent, Allah revealed concerning us what He revealed, and the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said concerning us what he said; yet they denied Allah and denied His Messenger, so they associated partners with Allah.
And as for the killing of the soul which Allah has forbidden, they killed al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام and his companions.
And as for consuming the wealth of the orphan, they took away our fayʾ, which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, had assigned to us, and gave it to others instead of us.
And as for disobedience to parents, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, revealed that in His Book, and He, Mighty and Majestic, said:
The Prophet has a greater claim on the believers than their own selves, and his wives are their mothers.
So they were undutiful to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله regarding his progeny, and they were undutiful to their mother Khadījah regarding her progeny.
And as for accusing the chaste woman, they accused Fāṭimah عليها السلام upon their pulpits.
And as for fleeing from the battlefield, they gave their bayʿah to Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام willingly, without compulsion, then they fled from him and abandoned him.
And as for denying our right, this is among that concerning which they do not dispute.

key_terms.الشِّرْكُ: associating partners with Allah; here linked to denying what Allah revealed about the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.الْفِرَارُ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ: fleeing from battle or abandoning the struggle
key_terms.حَقِّنَا: our right; the rightful claim of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.قَتْلُ النَّفْسِ: the killing of a soul unlawfully forbidden by Allah
key_terms.مَالِ الْيَتِيمِ: the wealth of the orphan; here applied to wrongful seizure of due property

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith interpret the seven major sins in relation to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains seven major sins by applying them to wrongs committed against the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It presents these sins as theological, moral, and historical violations, including denial of their divinely established right, the killing of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, usurpation of their due, and mistreatment of the Prophet’s family. It also cites the Qur’anic verse on the Prophet’s authority and the maternal status of his wives to frame loyalty to his progeny as a grave religious obligation.
